title: The Frog That Comes Back From Frozen
hook: A frog frozen solid is not a dead frog.
script: A frog frozen solid is not a dead frog. In winter, the wood frog's heart stops and it stops breathing. Up to two-thirds of the water in its body turns to ice. So how does anything survive that? Its cells fill with glucose, a sugar that stops ice from tearing them apart. For weeks, by any normal definition, it is dead. Then spring arrives. What happens when the ice melts? Its heart restarts on its own, with nothing to jump-start it. Within hours the frog is breathing, and soon it hops away alive.
